title: Challenges and Considerations with Code-Mixed NLP for Multilingual Societies

bias_targets.methodology: Critical analysis and survey of existing NLP resources demonstrating the structural lack of processing tools, datasets, benchmarks, and appropriate evaluation metrics for code-mixed languages (e.g., Hinglish) compared to monolingual languages.
Manual inspection of Hinglish sentiment classification datasets to identify label ambiguity and subjective errors introduced by the underlying biases of human annotators.
